default.what: what a user gets with aelix -e: the host's whole default list and the extension's six. aelix 0.1.0b2 in --mode json offers 14 tools (dry run, 2026-10-07): aelix_status, the six, read, bash, edit, write, grep, find, ls — similar tools that do not belong (aelix_status, grep, find, ls next to status and query) included

coding.what: aelix's coding tools and the extension's six: no aelix_status, grep, find or ls

analytics_read.what: read and the extension's six: no bash, so no way around the analytics tools

unrequested.what: on_demand, not requested: the task's requests only; no proposal search, notice or extra model tokens is expected (docs/SKILL-PROPOSAL-POLICY.md)

requested.what: on_demand, requested: one more request at the end asks for reuse candidates
requested.append_request: 이번 작업에서 다음에도 다시 쓸 만한 방법(스크립트·절차)이 있으면 근거(run·기록 ID)와 함께 제안해 줘. 적합한 것이 없으면 없다고 말해 줘.

always_on.what: always_on: needs the project's proposal mode setting, which kit 0.4.0 does not have
always_on.not_run_reason: kit has no proposal mode setting yet (Issue #17, ADR-0008); always_on cannot be configured

word_sets_note: Phrases the scorer reads (tools/model_eval.py): an ASCII phrase does not start inside a word; a verdict phrase is a whole word, the longest one wins, a negated one turns supported into false and back; resolved and superseded words do not count where negated (미해결, 해결되지 않은, not resolved).
